notes.title: JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
notes.content:
🔥 Join Our Community & Help Shape Push Through Hell! 🔥


We’re opening the doors for passionate players, creators, and curious minds to be part of the journey as we build Push Through Hell — a chaotic, action-packed roguelike top-down shooter.

Your feedback isn’t just welcome — it’s a core part of how this game will evolve. We want your ideas, your suggestions, and yes… even your wildest “what if?” moments.


🗨️ Join our Discord here:

https://discord.gg/hUAtScW5VF


Inside the server, you’ll get:


🎮 Playable prototypes — try early builds before anyone else.
💬 A direct channel to the dev — share your thoughts and get answers.
📝 Design discussions — help us shape mechanics, balance, and progression.
👀 Exclusive sneak peeks — new models, art, and experimental features.
📢 A place to be heard — your feedback can directly influence the final game.



Whether you live for roguelikes, can’t get enough of top-down shooters, or just want to be part of a game’s creation from the ground up, this is your chance.

Let’s make something amazing together. See you in Hell. 😈

— Kamil Graca
